page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some consonants are faint or broken by specks; the Hebrew forms are best readings and may contain errors. The printed page numbers at the head (left and right) are Hebrew letter signatures and are uncertain. The second catchword-like mark "y 1" at the lower right is not transcribed as a separate element. Latin glosses in italic are rendered in <i>. Hebrew letters on the left margin of some lines (for example the first word of "tensa me") are uncertain and marked [?].
